jobs.title: Stellarator Integration Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. As part of the integrated stellarator design team you will work in between plasma physics and technology and make sure that all stellarator systems are designed according to clear and optimal design criteria. You will ensure that modelling uncertainties are quantified and used appropriately. You will drive projects where overarching design solutions with multi-system trades need to be found. WHAT YOU WILL DO Ensure interfaces, design criteria, load cases and uncertainties are correctly defined: so that engineering design can iterate quickly and with clear assumptions. Understand systems interactions: in order to minimize unintended consequences of the main architectural decisions. Solve integration challenges: Identify, track, and solve the hardest integration challenges and risks of a machine not achieving its mission requirements. Harness simplification opportunities: Identify, track, and address the most promising opportunities that affect the Alpha architecture. WHO YOU ARE You've earned your engineering judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace or Formula 1. You are not afraid of different physics domains. You feel comfortable navigating the different physics regimes of a Stellarator - from waves propagating in a plasma to cryogenic properties of steel. You reach for whatever tool fits. Being a pen-and-paper calculation, a simulator you coded last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse. You build consensus. You are a low-ego high-clarity communicator who works effectively with multiple technical leads, to bring integration challenges and system-level tradeoffs to a clear decision. You commit to a concrete outcome. Every study, tool, and memo you produce ends in an actionable insight and a clear next step, otherwise it didn't happen. INTERVIEW

jobs.title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Mission Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen. Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde. Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben. Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen. Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch. Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender. Konkret: ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt. DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden. ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. Du bist die direkteste Leitung dorthin und nutzt sie. BEZIEHUNG STATT KONTAKTLISTE: Du übernimmst einen festen Kreis von Partnern. Nach drei Monaten kennen die deinen Namen, nicht unsere Rufnummer. SAUBER NACHHALTEN: Was besprochen wurde, landet nachvollziehbar in Hubspot, damit das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann. Dein Talent SUSTAINABILITY: Du interessierst dich sehr für Klimaschutz und Nachhaltigkeit und willst mehr darüber lernen und bewegen WORKING STUDENT: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium und bringst idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliches Engagement AM TELEFON ZU HAUSE: Du hast schon mal jemanden am Telefon von etwas überzeugt — im Job, im Verein, im Nebenjob, egal. AUF DEN PUNKT, OHNE KALT ZU WIRKEN: Du sagst in drei Sätzen, wofür andere zehn brauchen, und klingst dabei trotzdem wie ein Mensch. Handwerksbetriebe haben keine Zeit für Marketing-Sprache und merken sofort, wenn jemand welche spricht. ZUVERLÄSSIG, NICHT VERHANDELBAR: Zugesagter Rückruf am Donnerstag heißt Donnerstag. Das ist bei uns Grundvoraussetzung, keine Stärke. DU BRINGST WAS ZURÜCK: Nach fünfzig Gesprächen hast du eine Meinung dazu, was funktioniert. Du sagst sie, ohne dass wir danach fragen müssen. DEUTSCH AUF MUTTERSPRACHNIVEAU: Unsere Partner sind deutsche Handwerksbetriebe. Das Gespräch läuft auf Deutsch, inklusive Zwischentöne und Dialekt am anderen Ende. MINDESTENS 6 MONATE ZEIT: Kürzer lohnt sich für keinen von uns beiden. Bis du richtig gut in diesen Gesprächen bist, vergehen Wochen. Unser Angebot Wachstum & Kultur Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur fachlich durchstartet, sondern aktiv eine gesunde und nachhaltige Unternehmenskultur lebt. Bei uns zählt das Miteinander genauso viel wie der Erfolg. Impact & Awareness Deine Stimme hat Gewicht, im Büro und darüber hinaus. Neben deinem regulären Urlaub bekommst du zusätzliche freie Tage für Klimaaktivismus, Demos oder Projekte, die dir am Herzen liegen. Flexibilität & Vertrauen Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinem Rhythmus. Nutze unsere Flexdays, um mobil zu arbeiten – egal ob von zu Hause oder unterwegs innerhalb Deutschlands, immer in Absprache mit deinem Team. Extra B

jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategist - Social & Paid (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Was du bei uns machen wirst: Wie bringt man Menschen dazu, sich freiwillig mit ihrer Steuererklärung zu beschäftigen? Genau das ist deine Aufgabe. Als Performance Creative Strategist bei Zasta entwickelst du Ideen, Hooks und Kampagnen, die aus einem komplexen Finanzthema relevante und unterhaltsame Werbung machen – und gleichzeitig messbar performen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Paid Social, insbesondere Meta und TikTok. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, erfolgreiche Social-First-Ansätze auf TV zu übertragen und den Kanal gemeinsam mit uns neu zu denken. Dabei bekommst du viel konzeptionellen Freiraum: Du entwickelst neue Creative Angles, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze und findest über Daten, Zielgruppen-Insights und Testing heraus, welche Botschaften wirklich funktionieren. Zielgruppen wirklich verstehen : Du analysierst Zielgruppen, ihre Bedürfnisse und ihre Mediennutzung. Du weißt, wie sich Botschaften je nach Kanal und Funnel-Stufe unterscheiden müssen – und setzt genau dort an. Brücke zwischen Data & Kreativität sein : Du arbeitest eng mit Performance-Marketing, Data & Kreativ-Agenturen zur Ableitung und Optimierung von Creatives anhand von KPIs zusammen und übersetzt das in neue kreative Ansätze. TV neu denken : Du hast Lust, TV nicht als verstaubten Kanal zu sehen, sondern als Spielfeld für starke, moderne Markenkommunikation, die klare Performance bringt. Du bringst frische Ideen ein und denkst TV konsequent aus der Social-Logik heraus. Testing & Learnings vorantreiben : Du denkst in Iterationen, entwickelst Testing-Frameworks für Creatives und sorgst dafür, dass Learnings systematisch zurück in neue Konzepte fließen. Was du idealerweise mitbringst: Du hast fundierte Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy, Creative Conception, Art Direction oder Kampagnenentwicklung. I dealerweise warst du vorher in einem digitalen Performance-Umfeld tätig. Du bringst ein t iefes Verständnis für den Bereich Paid Social (z.B. Meta, TikTok) mit und hast Interesse oder erste Erfahrungen im TV-Umfeld. Du zeigst ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für leadorientierte Performance-Kampagnen und ein Gespür für Zielgruppenpsychologie- du kannst Insights, Daten und Business-Ziele in klare kreative Strategien übersetzen. Du bist neugierig, probierst Dinge aus und hast Lust, Konventionen zu hinterfragen. Du denkst nicht nur in Slides, sondern auch in konkreten Umsetzungen und setzt Ideen proaktiv um. Für die interne und externe Kommunikation sprichst du Deutsch auf C1-Level und bist sicher in der Nutzung gängiger englischer Marketing- und Strategy-Begriffe. Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau Was wir dir bieten: Wir sind ein profitables Unternehmen, das nachhaltig wächst. Unser Management kennt jeden, der bei uns arbeitet. Mit Büros in Rostock und Berlin kannst du frische Seeluft schnuppern oder dich vom Großstadtdschungel mitreißen lassen. Regelmäßige Besuche und Team-Events sorgen für das Gemeinschaftsgefühl. Je nach Standort treffen wir uns an zwei Tagen die Woche vor Ort im Büro - dienstags und mittwochs in Rostock und mittwochs und donnerstags in Berlin. Die restlichen Tage kannst du dir aussuchen, von wo aus du arbeitest. Falls du an den Präsenztagen mal nicht ins Büro kommen kannst, gibt es Jokertage, die du flexibel einsetzen kannst. Tapetenwechsel inklusive - bei Zasta hast du 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und die Möglichkeit, bis zu 4 Wochen am Stück innerhalb Europas zu arbeiten. Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen für diese Stelle erfüllst? Wir freuen uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bringst du etwas Besonderes in das Team ein, das wir bisher nicht in Betracht gezogen haben. Dein Kontakt bei Zasta: Wenn du Fragen zur Stelle hast, kannst du uns jederzeit über schreiben. Bewerbungen können wir nur online über die Plattform akzeptieren und werden auf anderem Wege nicht beachtet . Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Was du bei uns machen wirst: TL;DR Zasta ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App Stores (schau selbst auf deinem Handy in der Kategorie Finanzen nach). Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen unter anderem in den Bereichen IT-Infrastruktur, Server- und Cloud-Lösungen, Microsoft 365, Netzwerk und WLAN, IT-Sicherheit, Firewall, Managed Security, Backup und Recovery sowie persönlichem IT-Support . jobs.description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst das Onboarding neuer Vertriebspartner sowie ihrer Vertriebler und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Du betreust bestehende Vertriebspartner ganzheitlich, unterstützt sie durch fachliche und vertriebliche Impulse und trägst so entscheidend zu ihrem kontinuierlichen Erfolg bei. Du führst regelmäßig Schulungen für neue und bestehende Vertriebspartner sowie deren Vertriebler durch und sorgst so für eine stetige Verbesserung ihres Fachwissens und ihrer Verkaufsfertigkeiten. Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich die Planung, Organisation und Durchführung von vertrieblichen Veranstaltungen im Bereich PV und erneuerbare Energien, um Vertriebspartner bei der Erweiterung ihres Portfolios zu unterstützen. Du begleitest bei Bedarf unsere Vertriebspartner zu Kundenterminen vor Ort, um den Verkaufsprozess aktiv zu fördern und den direkten Austausch zu stärken. Du leistest hierbei aktive Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Vertragsabschlüssen und trägst so direkt zum gemeinsamen Geschäftserfolg bei. Du pflegst ein professionelles Relationship Management zu lokalen Führungskräften der Vertriebspartner und repräsentierst unser Unternehmen in allen Interaktionen souverän und überzeugend. Dein Profil Du verfügst über mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung. Du bist aber auch offen, dich in neue Themen wie PV-Vertrieb einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem großen Finanzvertrieb ist ein Plus. Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Eigenmotivation sowie hohe Resilienz mit und bewältigst auch anspruchsvolle Situationen zielorientiert und erfolgreich. Du bist ein leidenschaftlicher Coach, der Freude daran hat, Menschen zu entwickeln und ihnen dabei zu helfen, stetig besser zu werden. Du zeichnest dich durch einen starken Erfolgswillen aus, hast ein Auge für Details und bist stets ergebnisorientiert. Du bist es gewohnt, viel unterwegs zu sein, und schätzt den direkten Austausch mit Vertriebspartnern sowie Kunden vor Ort. Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache fließend in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachkenntnisse wie Türkisch, Russisch, Polnisch oder Rumänisch sind von Vorteil. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 1 Urlaubstag, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data. We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end. Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues. The Role The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following. One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it. You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder. What you might call yourself.  Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both. Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar.  The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it. Taste is the bar.  Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make  you  sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either. What this is not.  You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit. Requirements You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad : send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad. Serious prompt engineering : multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop. 3+ years building things that go to market : technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't. Enough code to be autonomous : Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow. Enough data fluency to be credible : you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses. Generalist instinct : you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times. Independence : you

jobs.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions. Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices. jobs.title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations
jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

jobs.title: Lead QA Engineer
jobs.description: Compensation: National: $114,000-$160,000 NYC/SF: $120,000-$170,000 Tempus AI is a cutting-edge clinical laboratory coupled with powerful automation capabilities. We continually strive to deliver quality results to our patients as quickly as possible. As a Lead QA Engineer, you will own the quality engineering strategy for a portfolio of in-house developed clinical software, including a HIPAA-compliant clinical order platform and its supporting data-query and ETL tooling, and you will be the senior-most technical voice on how we prove that software works. You will set the test architecture and automation standards that our Senior and mid-level QA engineers build against, own nightly regression and CI/CD test orchestration end to end, and lead release readiness and go/no-go decisions with evidence rather than opinion. Knowledge of genetic testing, molecular biology, or other scientific disciplines is a strong plus but is not required. This is a fantastic opportunity to shape how quality is engineered across a growing clinical software organization. Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end quality engineering strategy across the application portfolio: test architecture, tooling selection, coverage targets. • Set and enforce the automation framework architecture across multiple suites and repositories, reusable page objects and fixtures, shared utilities, dependency and version management, stable selectors, and act as the final reviewer on test-framework pull requests. • Own CI/CD test orchestration end to end (GitHub Actions or equivalent): deployment-triggered and nightly regression runs, health checks, artifact and version gating, reporting, and automated notification. • Lead release readiness and go/no-go: consolidate risk assessment, validation evidence, and quality metrics into a clear recommendation for engineering and product leadership. • Drive shift-left across the Agile Scrum teams you support, represent quality and testability in design reviews, requirements, and definition of ready/done, and build quality gates into the delivery pipeline rather than at the end of the sprint. • Own the compliance posture of our test practice for regulated components: HIPAA and SOX coverage, PHI handling, access controls, audit trails, and requirement-to-test-to-result traceability. Serve as the QA point of contact for audit and validation activities. • Define, publish, and act on quality metrics, automation coverage, flake rate, escape rate, MTTR, and regression runtime, and hold the organization to an improvement trend. • Mentor and grow the QA/SDET team, including Senior engineers: code review, pairing, framework onboarding, technical roadmap, and career development. Partner with hiring managers on interviewing, leveling, and onboarding. • Serve as the final escalation for complex or systemic failures that span product, environment, test data, and harness, and drive root cause to resolution across team boundaries. • Set the standard for non-functional testing (performance, load, resilience) and for responsible AI-assisted QA workflows, test authoring, failure triage, and coverage analysis, while keeping the team accountable for the correctness of every test that ships. • Partner with software engineering, DevOps, and product leadership, and represent quality in architecture, platform, and release-process decisions. • Stay hands-on: personally design, build, and maintain automation for the highest-risk areas of the portfolio, and validate scheduled night-time and off-hours deployments in lower and production environments. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in software QA or test engineering, with 7+ years of hands-on test automation, including 3+ years as the lead, staff, or principal-level technical owner of a test practice. • Demonstrated track record of owning test architecture and automation standards across multiple applications or teams, not just within a single suite. • Expert-level programming ability in Java and/or Python

jobs.title: Performance Engineer - Open Source
jobs.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We have created a new career path at Canonical for Performance Engineers who bring exceptional clarity to software performance, correctness and efficiency. We are adding these roles to every engineering team at the company. As an open source platform, we have teams that work at every level of the software stack - from the kernel up through server and desktop applications, all the way to the web. We are adding roles with this focus in every engineering team in the company, to act as drivers of performance engineering skills, tools, culture and insights to our entire product range . We have also created a central performance engineering team, where we will drive shared tools, dashboarding capabilities, measurement frameworks, analytical capabilities and skills. We call this career focus ' percorr ' because we have found that the same deep insights that enable sophisticated performance measurement and design also enable teams to improve their harnesses and frameworks for correctness. Understanding not only the application, but the runtime, the compiler, and the system, all the way down to the CPU, gives an engineer the ability to think creatively and with insight about the right things to measure, and the right ways to verify correctness. We have found that performance engineers will often improve the deepest and trickiest areas of our test harnesses, and unblock their teams to test and measure previously 'dark' aspects of their work. We also have teams that work with every major silicon vendor and cloud, with a particular emphasis on performance optimisation of the entire stack for that architecture, CPU family or hypervisor. Our goal is to ensure that Ubuntu users can select whatever platform they want for their workloads and know they have access to the very best performance and efficiency across the entire stack from kernel to codec. If they wish, we will enable performance and correctness engineers to move between products every two years, so that they have the opportunity to raise the bar for performance in an array of products over time, and also that teams have the benefit of fresh eyes on their processes, thinking, harnesses, dashboards and code. Our performance and correctness leads are expected to be truly exceptional individuals, and also leaders who are confident setting expectations of change, sharing insights and skills, running initiatives and programs. There is no way to move a meaningful codebase without also moving the people behind it. This is a career path for perfectionists and precision artists. Whether you have a particular language focus - C, C++, Rust, Golang, Python, Java, Flutter-Dart or others - or a particular love of the kernel or hardware or CPU instruction set, whether you see yourself as driving perceived user experience through performance or optimising the efficiency of data centers to reduce carbon footprint, this process is the best way to find a role at Canonical that speaks to your precision, rigour, insight and drive. Location : We have teams in every time zone, and can accommodate applications from almost any country. Nice-to-have skills we value Low-level CPU insights and assembly language - understanding cache, registers, vectorization, memory Kernel performance insights - scheduling, context

jobs.title: Lead SAP ABAP Developer
jobs.description: Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer , and it is the promise of why we were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery. SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms. We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end. A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future! About role As a Lead SAP ABAP Engineer you will drive the backend architecture and delivery of our cloud-based SaaS platform built on S/4HANA and SAP BTP technologies. You will design, develop and maintain scalable, secure, high-performance components, own technical decisions, and ensure clean‑core, upgrade‑safe extensibility across our Fioneer solutions. In this role you will lead and mentor a small team of ABAP engineers, collaborate closely with product owners, UX/Fiori leads and cross-functional stakeholders, and translate business needs into robust backend APIs, CDS/OData services and integration patterns. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, shaping architecture, and growing engineering talent while contributing to a next‑generation SaaS platform, this role is for you. Responsibilities Design, own and govern the architecture of scalable, secure backend components for innovative lending solutions built on ABAP and related SAP technologies. Define technical direction, coding standards, and best practices; drive adoption of clean‑core, upgrade‑safe extension patterns across teams. Lead implementation efforts, review designs and code, and ensure delivery of high‑quality standard software in an agile environment while collaborating with internal stakeholders, customers and partners. Partner strategically with front‑end developers, designers, and product owners to define end‑to‑end solutions, APIs (CDS/OData) and integration patterns. Diagnose, prioritize and resolve complex technical issues; coordinate incident response and post‑mortem actions to prevent recurrence. Ensure engineering excellence through structured testing strategies (unit, integration, UAT support), CI/CD pipelines, automated quality checks, performance tuning and continuous improvement initiatives. Mentor and grow ABAP engineers: conduct code reviews, provide technical coaching, run knowledge‑sharing sessions and support career development. Create, maintain and approve comprehensive technical documentation, runbooks and architectural artefacts. Drive platform readiness for cloud deployments, oversee security, observability and governance, and lead upgrade/migration planning. Stay current with innovations in S/4HANA, RAP and SAP BTP and evaluate their adoption to advance the platform roadmap. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. 10+ years of experience in ABAP object-oriented development, with substantial hands‑on work on S/4HANA (experience in the financial sector is a plus). Proven track record (3+ years) leading and mentoring engineering teams, driving technical decisions and delivery in enterprise SAP projects. Deep proficiency in OData, Core Data Services (CDS), and ABAP RESTful Application Programming (RAP). Practical experience with SAP BTP (services, deployment approaches, integration concepts) and cloud readiness for enterprise solutions. Strong architecture and design skills: defining extension patterns, clean‑core strategies, multi‑tenant SaaS considerations, and upgrade‑safe solutions. Experience with CI/CD for ABAP, automated testing strategies, performance tuning, observability, and operational readiness.

jobs.title: Director, Product Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description: About the Role Millions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance. As AI reshapes professional work, our customers expect software that is more intelligent, integrated and effective. Meeting those expectations requires rethinking how products are discovered, built, launched, measured and improved. This newly created role reflects Wolters Kluwer 's commitment to transforming how products are built in the age of AI. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Product Strategy & Transformation, you will help lead that evolution from the Corporate Strategy Office. Working in a small enterprise team, you will partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to strengthen the Product System and improve customer value, business outcomes and speed of innovation. A key focus will be advancing the Agentic Product Development Lifecycle (Agentic PDLC), using AI across product development. You will combine deep product expertise with a hands-on transformation mindset to implement and scale change. How You Will Work This is a senior individual-contributor role, leading through expertise, coaching, facilitation and influence. You will embed with business-unit teams on high-priority lighthouse initiatives, apply modern product practices and AI-enabled workflows, and turn proven approaches into reusable tools and operating practices for broader adoption. The role can be based remotely in any country where Wolters Kluwer has an office and will require travel of approximately 35% to work directly with teams and stakeholders. What You Will Do Partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities and connect product decisions to customer and business outcomes. Define, pilot and scale Wolters Kluwer 's Agentic PDLC and broader AI-enabled product development capabilities. Lead lighthouse engagements across product strategy, discovery, experimentation, delivery, launch and measurement. Embed with cross-functional teams to diagnose barriers, build trust and translate insight into practical change. Coach product leaders and improve operating models, portfolio practices, governance and metrics. Turn effective practices into repeatable tools, learning experiences and standards for enterprise adoption. Establish success measures, demonstrate impact and use evidence to guide broader rollout. Required Experience & Qualifications 8+ years of hands-on Product Management and/or Product Leadership experience in B2B software, SaaS or technology companies. Ownership of strategy and outcomes for a substantial product, platform or portfolio, from customer discovery through delivery and measurement. A track record of leading cross-functional product, engineering and design teams to meaningful customer and business outcomes. Strong product craft across discovery, strategy, experimentation, prioritization, roadmaps, launch and measurement. Recent hands-on experience building AI-enabled or agentic products, transforming product development workflows through AI, or both. Ability to enter unfamiliar contexts, diagnose root causes, build trust and translate insight into action. Proven influence on product direction, operating models or organizational effectiveness beyond a single team, without relying on formal authority. Strong analytical, communication, storytelling and facilitation skills, with the judgment to simplify complexity and align senior leaders. Preferred Experience Leading product transformation, operating-model change or organizational scaling initiatives. Coaching product leaders and strengthening product management practices. Working across multiple businesses, portfolios or complex matrixed organizations. Scaling reusable capabilities such as playbooks, metrics, communities of practice or leadership-development programs.
